newsitem.title: USA: Seagull starts natgas production in La. well.
newsitem.headline: Seagull starts natgas production in La. well.

text.p: Seagull Energy Corp said Wednesday that it has begun production at its Colvin "B" No. 4 well, an onshore natural gas discovery well in Lincoln Parish, La., about 70 miles east of Shreveport.
The well was drilled to nearly 12,500 feet and encountered 117 feet of productive gas sands in two zones, it said.
It said the initial production rate is 3.5 million cubic feet of gas per day from one of the zones, which it described as a 40-foot Jurassic age Gray sand.
A second zone will be developed in the future through a separate drilling program and further drilling is also planned for the Gray sand later in 1997, it said.
